notes: Config/parity scenario (no DML fixture) per brief. Active proc Rev_Mgmt_Default_Pricing_Procedure V21 single-Active, bound to SalesTransactionContextExt_v2 v23 single-Active ContextDefinitionVersion = quote+order version parity holds. The 15 V21 staging fields that historically broke order-side context-fetch (project_v16_order_pricing_contextfetch_incident: Pre_Partner_Price__c/Partner_Pricing_Source__c added QLI-only; project_reprice_contextdef_error: Prior_Partner_Discount__c/Prior_Discretionary_Discount__c missing on OrderEntitiesMapping) are now ALL mapped on BOTH item nodes -> both fixes durable in V21/v23. NetUnitPrice persist name is correct on both sides; ItemNetTotalPrice never appears. Smoke-tested headlessly via REST place(Force/Skip) on a real UI-priced partner Quote and on a real converted Order, plus read-only parity on the same quote's converted+activated order line. defect_provenance SC-3384/reprice-contextDef = NOT reproduced under V21 (both were pre-V21 incidents, since resolved by adding the OrderItem fields + OrderEntitiesMapping rows and re-syncing the context). DURABILITY NOTE (governance, not a defect today): parity is correct in live v23 but is maintained by hand-added OrderEntitiesMapping rows; per the general rule, any future V-version that references a NEW staging field must add it on BOTH QuoteLineItem AND OrderItem + BOTH context nodes + re-sync the context, or the order side will hard-fail context-fetch again. VALIDATION ONLY: no deploys, no proc/flow/context edits; the only DML was Force-reprice on existing Draft records.
verdict_reason: Quote and converted order both price through the single shared SalesTransactionContextExt_v2 v23 under the single Active proc V21; all 15 V21 staging fields (incl. the V16/contextDef-gack culprits Pre_Partner_Price__c, Partner_Pricing_Source__c, Prior_*) hydrate+persist identically on both QuoteLineItem and OrderItem nodes, NetUnitPrice maps correctly (no ItemNetTotalPrice), and both reprice paths return isSuccess:true with no contextDefinition gack.
